captions.detailed: This is a 3D model of a double-barrel floor pump. It features a broad, black rectangular base supporting two parallel, silver-colored cylindrical pump barrels topped with blue caps. A single, horizontal black T-handle is mounted on a blue bridge piece, which is connected to two thin, silver-colored sliding rods. The handle and its attached rods are designed to slide vertically (prismatically) up and down along the axes of the dual pump cylinders.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a double-barrel floor pump using CadQuery. The model should feature a wide rectangular base, two parallel vertical cylinder barrels, and a shared horizontal T-handle that connects to dual sliding rods. Ensure the T-handle assembly is modeled with a prismatic joint to allow translation along the cylinders' vertical axes.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base assembly using a Box for the foot stand, Cylinders for the twin parallel pump barrels, and smaller Cylinder/Box primitives for the blue cylinder caps and the pressure gauge assembly. It then models the moving handle assembly using a horizontal Cylinder for the grip, a central connecting Box, and two thin vertical Cylinders representing the sliding plungers. Finally, it defines a prismatic joint along the Z-axis to connect the handle assembly to the base assembly.
